who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane barrier (V14) under proofs-1113
what: a_crash_keeps_what_a_barrier_ordered is false of its generated model: wf and small bound no file's number of barriers, and Vec.push fails at usize::MAX elements, so a well-formed small disk whose file has 2^64-1 barriers makes Disk::barrier panic and the theorem function never returns true
cost: the lane stopped before writing any proof
cause: File::small bounds changes (MOST_CHANGES) but not barriers; the Vec model allows lengths up to usize::MAX while a real Vec<Barrier> holds at most isize::MAX / 16
whys: the bounds in small were written for byte lengths and change counts the theorems compute; a push onto barriers was not counted as a length that can overflow; the Vec model takes usize::MAX as the bound for every element type
class: a theorem hypothesis that misses a bound a model operation needs (push overflow on an unbounded Vec)
prevention: File::small checks barriers.len() <= MOST_CHANGES; or the Vec model bounds length by isize::MAX / size_of::<T>() for sized non-ZST T, which makes every push on a Vec under the bound provably safe
workaround: none in the proof: the statement must change
